name: Splashell at the campfire
notes: Splashell on the intro screen. It only shows once it is unlocked (unlocked >= 3) and sits on the half circle behind the fire: its seat depends on how many monsters are unlocked, all of them spread evenly from left to right in roster order, so with 3 unlocked it takes seat 3. It always looks at the fire (view per number unlocked: 3: down-left, 4: down, 5: down, 6: down, 7: down-right, 8: down-right, 9: down-right). When it is shiny it shimmers through the rainbow, like everywhere else.
